_comment: Named or widely reported GE Vernova customers and counterparties that file with the SEC. Their filings are pulled through the EDGAR path (with exhibits) and run through the `project` extractor. Tickers only - CIKs are resolved at run time from SEC's company_tickers.json so nothing here can go stale. Start narrow: named customers, not every utility.

customers.why: NextEra - largest US utility/renewables owner; gas turbine and wind counterparty
Duke Energy - large combined-cycle build program, named 7HA customer
Dominion - data-center-driven load growth in Virginia, gas additions
Southern Company - Georgia Power gas capacity additions
Entergy - Louisiana/Mississippi gas plants tied to data centers
American Electric Power - large-load agreements, gas capacity
Xcel Energy - gas peakers and combined cycle in IRPs
Vistra - IPP with gas fleet and data-center deals
NRG - announced GE Vernova turbine reservations for new gas plants
Constellation - large-load contracts, gas and nuclear fleet
Chevron - joint venture with GE Vernova and Engine No. 1 for data-center gas power
Kinder Morgan - gas infrastructure serving new generation
Meta - Louisiana data center with new gas generation
Alphabet - power procurement, occasional turbine references
Amazon - data-center power, nuclear and gas deals
